_about: Reviewed expectations for real_samples/. Every file in this folder must have an entry. 'verified' says how a human confirmed the expectation; update it when an expectation changes.

cover_unmapped.pdf.verified: 1-page cover over a full-page background image whose font ToUnicode CMap omits glyph 0x0001 between 'Department' and 'of': flagged unmapped_glyphs + full_page_image_under_text, replaced with U+FFFD on parse.

events.json.verified: 10-record top-level JSON array. Probe counts .json as not_inspected; parse_json extracts all 10 objects with top_level='list'.

inventory.xlsx.verified: Field Descriptions has a single-cell title in A1 above the real header, flagged possible_title_row. Inventory has 3 data rows, sparse nulls, and a trailing blank row trimmed by parse_xlsx.

project_report.pdf.verified: 2-page born-digital report with a 24pt letter-spaced title ('PROJECT REPORT', extracted cleanly under the 0.22 em font-relative word gap), a soft-hyphenated word ('minority-owned'), and a ruled 3x3 table on page 1.

template.docx.verified: Word template with nested headings H1-H4 (no skips), 2 action-step tables, 6 body paragraphs, and 2 short bold form prompts flagged as possible_unstyled_headings.

type3_unnamed.pdf.verified: 2-page PDF whose Type 3 font uses numeric /Differences glyph names (/0, /1, /2, ...) starting at code 32 and no /ToUnicode. Rejected by the gate with font_without_unicode_map; recognised by parse_ocr via PDFium + Tesseract.
